clips.title: The story
paras: At Menethil Harbor, Archaeologist Flagongut keeps in touch with field researchers across the Great Sea. The dwarven scholar of the Explorers' League is staying at the Deepwater Tavern while bound for the Whelgar Excavation Site.

Archaeologist Flagongut rests with a mug at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. Like many members of Ironforge's Explorers' League, he traveled west across Khaz Modan to help with discoveries near the Whelgar Excavation Site in the Wetlands. Though far from the high halls of the library, he keeps ties with field researchers, processing lost relics and reports carried across the Great Sea from distant expeditions.

Dwarven curiosity reaches beyond one continent. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus sends Flagongut the mysterious fossil unearthed in Darkshore by the absent-minded Prospector Remtravel. Flagongut is amazed: he once brought a similar fossil to the Explorers' League's annual conference in Ironforge, convinced it held a power that could somehow be unlocked.
